title: Lease renewal reminder
description: Tell tenants their lease is ending and invite them to renew on WhatsApp, with new rent and response deadline. Utility renewal template.
notes: Keep it about their existing lease. Do not advertise other units or promotions in the same message.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your lease for {{unit}} ends on {{end_date}}. We would love to have you stay. The renewal rent would be *{{new_rent}}* per month. Please let us know by {{deadline}} if you would like to renew.
